SaffronCity_HomeM_Text_Beat3.en: An hour well spent... for you.

SaffronCity_HomeM_Text_Beat5.en: A whole year lost to you...

SaffronCity_HomeM_Text_Clear.en: All five down! Time itself bows to\nyou. Take these as proof.
SaffronCity_HomeM_Text_Clear.fr: Les cinq à terre ! Le temps\nlui-même s'incline. Prends ça comme\lpreuve.

SaffronCity_HomeM_Text_Decline.en: Time waits for no one. But I will.
SaffronCity_HomeM_Text_Decline.fr: Le temps n'attend personne. Mais\nmoi, si.

SaffronCity_HomeM_Text_Early.en: Not yet. Come back with all 8\nBADGES.

SaffronCity_HomeM_Text_Go.fr: Alors commence. La SECONDE est la\npremière.

SaffronCity_HomeM_Text_Intro.en: This is the TRIAL TOWER. Five\nrivals, back to back, no healing\pbetween rounds. Ready to race the\nclock?
SaffronCity_HomeM_Text_Intro.fr: Ceci est la TOUR D'ÉPREUVE. Cinq\nrivaux, à la suite, sans soin entre\lles manches. Prêt à défier la\nmontre ?

SaffronCity_HomeM_Text_NoRoom.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
SaffronCity_HomeM_Text_NoRoom.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.
